question: Which of the following statements about the meta-analysis is correct?

options.opa: The objective of the meta-analysis is to quantitatively summarize the results of the studies carried out.
options.opb: The meta-analysis is a large clinical trial.
options.opc: It would be desirable to avoid negative clinical trials, as well as unpublished ones, to prevent selection biases.
options.opd: By definition, all meta-analyzes are a reliable source of evidence, the quality of the trials being irrelevant or if they include the results of randomized clinical trials.
options.ope: The meta-analysis will correct the errors of carrying out the tests.

analysis: Meta-analysis aims to quantitatively summarize the results of multiple studies to provide a more comprehensive understanding of a particular research question. It is important to include all relevant studies, regardless of their outcomes, to minimize bias and provide a more accurate estimate of the effect size.
